--!nonstrict
-- Pure, shared algorithm. Live results are built once by RoundService, never from client stats.
local Config = require(script.Parent.EndCinematicConfig)
local Ranking = {}
local function finite(value) return type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge end
local function metric(value) return finite(value) and value>=0 and value%1==0 end

function Ranking.Build(participants, winningTeam, mode, identity)
 local entries, seen = {}, {}
 for _, source in ipairs(participants) do
  assert(finite(source.UserId) and source.UserId~=0 and not seen[source.UserId], "InvalidRankingParticipant")
  seen[source.UserId]=true
  local row={UserId=source.UserId,DisplayName=source.DisplayName,Username=source.Username,
   Team=source.Team,CompetitiveSlot=source.CompetitiveSlot or source.Slot,
   DescriptionKey=source.DescriptionKey,Preview=source.Preview==true}
  if identity.Preview and source.Preview then row.AppearanceUserId=source.AppearanceUserId end
  for _, key in ipairs({"Goals","Kills","Deaths","MatchPoints"}) do
   if metric(source[key]) then row[key]=source[key] end -- absent stays absent, never fabricated zero
  end
  table.insert(entries,row)
 end
 table.sort(entries,function(a,b)
  for _, key in ipairs(Config.Ranking.Criteria) do
   local x,y=a[key],b[key]
   if x~=y then
    if x==nil then return false end
    if y==nil then return true end
    return Config.Ranking.Ascending[key] and x<y or (not Config.Ranking.Ascending[key] and x>y)
   end
  end
  return a.UserId<b.UserId -- original IDs, including Studio negatives
 end)
 local mvp
 for rank,row in ipairs(entries) do
  row.Rank=rank
  if rank==1 then
   for _,key in ipairs(Config.Ranking.Criteria) do if row[key]~=nil then mvp=row.UserId; break end end
  end
  row.IsMVP=row.UserId==mvp
 end
 local visible={}
 -- Four winners maximum in the authorized modes. Physical stand five stays reserved.
 -- Keep all participants in the ranking, but never fill unused stands with losers.
 local capacity=math.min(4,Config.Winners.MaxVisible,Config.Ranking.MaxVisible)
 for _,row in ipairs(entries) do
  if row.Team==winningTeam and #visible<capacity then
   local copy=table.clone(row); copy.CinematicSlot=#visible+1
   table.insert(visible,copy)
  end
 end
 local snapshot={SessionId=identity.SessionId,StateVersion=identity.StateVersion,
  WinningTeam=winningTeam,Entries=entries,VisibleParticipants=visible,MVPUserId=mvp,
  SelectionPolicy="WinningTeamOnly",Preview=identity.Preview==true}
 for _,row in ipairs(entries) do table.freeze(row) end
 for _,row in ipairs(visible) do table.freeze(row) end
 table.freeze(entries); table.freeze(visible)
 return table.freeze(snapshot)
end

function Ranking.Validate(snapshot, sessionId, version)
 if type(snapshot)~="table" or snapshot.SessionId~=sessionId or snapshot.StateVersion~=version
  or type(snapshot.Entries)~="table" or type(snapshot.VisibleParticipants)~="table"
  or #snapshot.VisibleParticipants>4
  or (snapshot.WinningTeam~="Red" and snapshot.WinningTeam~="Blue" and snapshot.WinningTeam~="Draw") then return false end
 local seen={}
 for i,row in ipairs(snapshot.Entries) do
  if type(row)~="table" or not finite(row.UserId) or row.UserId==0 or seen[row.UserId]
   or row.Rank~=i or type(row.DisplayName)~="string"
   or (row.Team~="Red" and row.Team~="Blue") then return false end
  for _,key in ipairs({"Goals","Kills","Deaths","MatchPoints"}) do
   if row[key]~=nil and not metric(row[key]) then return false end
  end
  seen[row.UserId]=row
 end
 local visible={}
 local expected={}
 for _,row in ipairs(snapshot.Entries) do
  if row.Team==snapshot.WinningTeam and #expected<math.min(4,Config.Winners.MaxVisible,Config.Ranking.MaxVisible) then
   table.insert(expected,row)
  end
 end
 if #snapshot.VisibleParticipants~=#expected then return false end
 for i,row in ipairs(snapshot.VisibleParticipants) do
  if type(row)~="table" then return false end
  local original=seen[row.UserId]
  if not original or original~=expected[i] or visible[row.UserId] or row.CinematicSlot~=i or row.Rank~=original.Rank
   or row.Team~=snapshot.WinningTeam or row.DisplayName~=original.DisplayName
   or row.Username~=original.Username or row.CompetitiveSlot~=original.CompetitiveSlot
   or row.DescriptionKey~=original.DescriptionKey or row.IsMVP~=original.IsMVP then return false end
  for _,key in ipairs({"Goals","Kills","Deaths","MatchPoints"}) do
   if row[key]~=original[key] then return false end
  end
  visible[row.UserId]=true
 end
 return true
end

function Ranking.Resolve(data, isMatch)
 if data.ResultSnapshot then
  if type(data.ResultSnapshot)=="table" and data.ResultSnapshot.WinningTeam==data.WinningTeam and Ranking.Validate(data.ResultSnapshot,data.MatchId,data.StateVersion) then return data.ResultSnapshot end
  return nil,"InvalidResultSnapshot"
 end
 if isMatch then return nil,"ResultSnapshotMissing" end
 return Ranking.Build(data.Participants or data.Winners,data.WinningTeam,data.Mode or "1v1",
  {SessionId=data.MatchId,StateVersion=data.StateVersion,Preview=true})
end
return Ranking

--!strict
-- MatchmakingService
-- Gestiona la detección de jugadores en zonas de matchmaking genéricas (1v1, 2v2, 3v3),
-- construye el QueueSnapshot autoritativo, controla la capacidad por equipo y despacha
-- partidas hacia RoundService.
-- La instancia física (zoneFolder) es la identidad primaria interna de la zona.
-- NO se encarga de efectos audiovisuales (delegado a MatchmakingFeedbackService)
-- ni de la presentación visual del HUD (delegado a MatchmakingController).

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Types = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Types)

type QueueSnapshot = Types.QueueSnapshot
type MatchmakingZoneConfig = Types.MatchmakingZoneConfig
type QueueStateName = Types.QueueStateName

export type ZoneData = {
	ZoneId: string,
	Instance: Folder,
	ZoneName: string,
	Config: MatchmakingZoneConfig,
	RedPads: { BasePart },
	BluePads: { BasePart },
	PadOccupants: { [BasePart]: { Player } },
	OccupantLastSeen: { [Player]: number },
	CandidateArrivals: { [Player]: number },
	CandidateLastSeen: { [Player]: number },
	CurrentRed: { Player },
	CurrentBlue: { Player },
	State: QueueStateName,
	ActiveReservation: Types.TeamMatchReservation?,
	LastModeNotPlayableWarn: string?,
}

local MatchmakingService = {}
MatchmakingService.Name = "MatchmakingService"

MatchmakingService._context = nil :: any
MatchmakingService._zones = {} :: { [Folder]: ZoneData }
MatchmakingService._latestSnapshots = {} :: { [string]: QueueSnapshot }
MatchmakingService._checkConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
MatchmakingService._lastCheck = 0
MatchmakingService._queueStatusRemote = nil :: RemoteEvent?
MatchmakingService._containerConnections = {} :: { RBXScriptConnection }
MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap = {} :: { [Model]: any }

-- Obtiene el Player asociado a una parte de un personaje
local function getPlayerFromPart(part: BasePart): Player?
	local current: Instance? = part
	while current and current ~= workspace do
		if current:IsA("Model") then
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(current)
			if player then
				return player
			end
			if MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap and MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap[current] then
				return MatchmakingService._testCharacterMap[current]
			end
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

local PAD_DETECTION_HEIGHT = 6.0
local OCCUPANT_GRACE_PERIOD = 0.8 -- Segundos de gracia para tolerar saltos y fluctuaciones espaciales

-- Valida si un jugador está conectado, con personaje instanciado en workspace y Humanoid vivo
local function isPlayerAliveAndValid(player: any): boolean
	local isRealPlayer = typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") and player:IsDescendantOf(Players)
	local isSimulated = typeof(player) == "table" and player.IsSimulatedPlayer == true
	if not isRealPlayer and not isSimulated then return false end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	return true
end

-- Detecta los jugadores físicos dentro del volumen de un pad usando GetPartBoundsInBox
local function getPhysicallyPresentPlayersOnPad(pad: BasePart, overlapParams: OverlapParams): { Player }
	local boxCFrame = pad.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, (pad.Size.Y / 2) + (PAD_DETECTION_HEIGHT / 2), 0)
	local boxSize = Vector3.new(pad.Size.X, PAD_DETECTION_HEIGHT, pad.Size.Z)
	local touchingParts = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boxCFrame, boxSize, overlapParams)

	local presentList: { Player } = {}
	local seen: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

	for _, part in ipairs(touchingParts) do
		local player = getPlayerFromPart(part)
		if player and not seen[player] then
			if isPlayerAliveAndValid(player) then
				seen[player] = true
				table.insert(presentList, player)
			end
		end
	end

	return presentList
end

-- Actualiza autoritativamente la ocupación de un conjunto de pads (equipo) aplicando
-- prioridad por orden de llegada (FIFO), reserva por plaza, grace period y prevención de doble ocupación.
local function updateTeamOccupants(
	zone: ZoneData,
	pads: { BasePart },
	maxTeamCapacity: number,
	otherTeamOccupantsSet: { [Player]: boolean },
	overlapParams: OverlapParams,
	now: number,
	service: any
): { Player }
	if #pads == 0 or maxTeamCapacity <= 0 then
		return {}
	end

	local padCapacity = math.max(1, math.ceil(maxTeamCapacity / #pads))

	-- 1. Detección física en cada pad del equipo
	local presentByPad: { [BasePart]: { [Player]: boolean } } = {}
	local allPresentOnTeam: { [Player]: boolean } = {}

	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local presentList = getPhysicallyPresentPlayersOnPad(pad, overlapParams)
		local padSet: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(presentList) do
			padSet[p] = true
			allPresentOnTeam[p] = true
		end
		presentByPad[pad] = padSet
	end

	-- 2. Retención de ocupantes existentes (con grace period)
	local assignedThisTeam: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	local teamOccupantsList: { Player } = {}

	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local currentOccupants = zone.PadOccupants[pad] or {}
		local retained: { Player } = {}
		local presentSet = presentByPad[pad] or {}

		for _, occupant in ipairs(currentOccupants) do
			if not isPlayerAliveAndValid(occupant) then
				-- Jugador muerto o desconectado: liberación inmediata sin periodo de gracia
				zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateArrivals[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateLastSeen[occupant] = nil
			elseif assignedThisTeam[occupant] or otherTeamOccupantsSet[occupant] then
				-- Conflicto: ya asignado a otra plaza o al equipo contrario
				zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateArrivals[occupant] = nil
				zone.CandidateLastSeen[occupant] = nil
			else
				if presentSet[occupant] then
					-- Físicamente presente: retiene plaza y actualiza marca temporal
					zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = now
					assignedThisTeam[occupant] = true
					table.insert(retained, occupant)
					table.insert(teamOccupantsList, occupant)
				else
					-- Ausente físicamente en este frame: comprobar periodo de gracia (tolerancia a saltos/jitter)
					local lastSeen = zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] or 0
					if (now - lastSeen) <= OCCUPANT_GRACE_PERIOD then
						assignedThisTeam[occupant] = true
						table.insert(retained, occupant)
						table.insert(teamOccupantsList, occupant)
					else
						-- Gracia expirada: abandono confirmado, liberar plaza
						zone.OccupantLastSeen[occupant] = nil
						zone.CandidateArrivals[occupant] = nil
						zone.CandidateLastSeen[occupant] = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end

		zone.PadOccupants[pad] = retained
	end

	-- 3. Registro de candidatos esperando en los pads
	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local presentSet = presentByPad[pad] or {}
		for p in pairs(presentSet) do
			if not assignedThisTeam[p] and not otherTeamOccupantsSet[p] then
				if not service:_isPlayerOccupantInOtherZone(p, zone) then
					if zone.CandidateArrivals[p] == nil then
						zone.CandidateArrivals[p] = now
					end
					zone.CandidateLastSeen[p] = now
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 4. Asignación de plazas disponibles por orden de llegada (FIFO)
	for _, pad in ipairs(pads) do
		local retained = zone.PadOccupants[pad] or {}
		local padSlotsAvailable = padCapacity - #retained
		local teamSlotsAvailable = maxTeamCapacity - #teamOccupantsList

		if padSlotsAvailable > 0 and teamSlotsAvailable > 0 then
			local presentSet = presentByPad[pad] or {}
			local candidates: { Player } = {}

			for p in pairs(presentSet) do
				if not assignedThisTeam[p]
					and not otherTeamOccupantsSet[p]
					and not service:_isPlayerOccupantInOtherZone(p, zone)
					and not table.find(retained, p) then
					table.insert(candidates, p)
				end
			end

			-- Ordenar candidatos por orden de llegada estricto
			table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
				local timeA = zone.CandidateArrivals[a] or math.huge
				local timeB = zone.CandidateArrivals[b] or math.huge
				if timeA == timeB then
					return a.UserId < b.UserId
				end
				return timeA < timeB
			end)

			local toAssign = math.min(padSlotsAvailable, teamSlotsAvailable, #candidates)
			for i = 1, toAssign do
				local chosen = candidates[i]
				table.insert(retained, chosen)
				table.insert(teamOccupantsList, chosen)
				assignedThisTeam[chosen] = true
				zone.OccupantLastSeen[chosen] = now
			end

			zone.PadOccupants[pad] = retained
		end
	end

	-- 5. Limpieza de candidatos que se retiraron (respetando gracia para evitar pérdida por salto)
	for candidate, lastSeen in pairs(zone.CandidateLastSeen) do
		if not allPresentOnTeam[candidate] and not assignedThisTeam[candidate] then
			if (now - lastSeen) > OCCUPANT_GRACE_PERIOD then
				zone.CandidateArrivals[candidate] = nil
				zone.CandidateLastSeen[candidate] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	return teamOccupantsList
end

-- Attributes describe an authorized mode; they never define a new mode or its capacity.
local function getZoneConfiguration(zoneFolder: Folder): (MatchmakingZoneConfig?, string?)
	local modeAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("Mode")
	local teamSizeAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("TeamSize")
	local maxPerTeamAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("MaxPlayersPerTeam")
	local totalAttr = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("TotalPlayers")

	local modeName = if type(modeAttr) == "string" and modeAttr ~= "" then modeAttr else zoneFolder.Name
	local configDefaults = Config.Matchmaking and Config.Matchmaking.Modes and Config.Matchmaking.Modes[modeName]

	if not configDefaults then return nil, "UnknownMode" end
	for _, entry in ipairs({
		{ Value = teamSizeAttr, Expected = configDefaults.TeamSize },
		{ Value = maxPerTeamAttr, Expected = configDefaults.MaxPlayersPerTeam },
		{ Value = totalAttr, Expected = configDefaults.TotalPlayers },
	}) do
		if entry.Value ~= nil and entry.Value ~= entry.Expected then
			return nil, "ModeCapacityMismatch"
		end
	end

	return {
		Mode = modeName,
		TeamSize = configDefaults.TeamSize,
		MaxPlayersPerTeam = configDefaults.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
		TotalPlayers = configDefaults.TotalPlayers,
	}
end

-- Verifica si un ZoneId ya está tomado por otra zona activa
function MatchmakingService:_isZoneIdTaken(zoneId: string, currentFolder: Folder): boolean
	for folder, data in pairs(self._zones) do
		if folder ~= currentFolder and data.ZoneId == zoneId then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Verifica si un jugador ya ocupa autoritativamente un pad en otra zona diferente
function MatchmakingService:_isPlayerOccupantInOtherZone(player: Player, currentZone: ZoneData): boolean
	for _, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		if zone ~= currentZone then
			if table.find(zone.CurrentRed, player) or table.find(zone.CurrentBlue, player) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function MatchmakingService:Init(context)
	self._context = context
	self._zones = {}
	self._latestSnapshots = {}
	self._containerConnections = {}
	_G.MatchmakingService = self

	-- Garantizar Remote de estado de cola
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local mmFolder = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Matchmaking")
	local queueRemote = mmFolder and mmFolder:FindFirstChild("QueueStatus")
	if queueRemote and queueRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		self._queueStatusRemote = queueRemote
	end

	-- Descubrir zonas en Workspace.ZoneMatchmaking
	local zoneContainer = workspace:FindFirstChild("ZoneMatchmaking")
	if not zoneContainer then
		warn("[MatchmakingService] No se encontro Workspace.ZoneMatchmaking")
		return
	end

	-- Registrar todas las zonas existentes
	for _, child in ipairs(zoneContainer:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			self:_registerZone(child)
		end
	end

	-- Conectar descubrimiento dinámico en tiempo de ejecución (Runtime Add / Remove)
	table.insert(self._containerConnections, zoneContainer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child: Instance)
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			-- Dar un frame para asegurar inicialización de atributos y jerarquía en caso de clonación
			task.defer(function()
				if child.Parent == zoneContainer then
					self:_registerZone(child)
				end
			end)
		end
	end))

	table.insert(self._containerConnections, zoneContainer.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child: Instance)
		if child:IsA("Folder") then
			self:_unregisterZone(child)
		end
	end))
end

function MatchmakingService:_registerZone(zoneFolder: Folder)
	if not zoneFolder or not zoneFolder:IsA("Folder") then return end
	if self._zones[zoneFolder] then return end

	local config, configError = getZoneConfiguration(zoneFolder)
	if not config then
		-- Decorative folders have no join pads and are not matchmaking zones.
		if zoneFolder:FindFirstChild("joins-parts") then
			warn(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona rechazada '%s': %s", zoneFolder.Name, tostring(configError)))
		end
		return
	end
	local joinsFolder = zoneFolder:FindFirstChild("joins-parts")

	local redPads: { BasePart } = {}
	local bluePads: { BasePart } = {}

	if joinsFolder then
		for _, part in ipairs(joinsFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local teamAttr = part:GetAttribute("Team")
				if teamAttr == "Red" or part.Name == "Red" or part.Name:find("Red") then
					table.insert(redPads, part)
				elseif teamAttr == "Blue" or part.Name == "Blue" or part.Name:find("Blue") then
					table.insert(bluePads, part)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if #redPads == 0 or #bluePads == 0 then
		warn(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona rechazada '%s': MissingTeamPads", zoneFolder.Name))
		return
	end
	table.sort(redPads, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	table.sort(bluePads, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)

	-- Generación de ZoneId único
	local attrId = zoneFolder:GetAttribute("ZoneId")
	local zoneId: string
	if typeof(attrId) == "string" and attrId ~= "" then
		if self:_isZoneIdTaken(attrId, zoneFolder) then
			warn(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona rechazada '%s': DuplicateZoneId", zoneFolder.Name))
			return
		end
		zoneId = attrId
	else
		local baseId = "Zone_" .. zoneFolder.Name
		local uniqueId = baseId
		local counter = 1
		while self:_isZoneIdTaken(uniqueId, zoneFolder) do
			counter += 1
			uniqueId = string.format("%s_%d", baseId, counter)
		end
		zoneId = uniqueId
	end

	local padOccupants: { [BasePart]: { Player } } = {}
	for _, pad in ipairs(redPads) do
		padOccupants[pad] = {}
	end
	for _, pad in ipairs(bluePads) do
		padOccupants[pad] = {}
	end

	local zoneData: ZoneData = {
		ZoneId = zoneId,
		Instance = zoneFolder,
		ZoneName = zoneFolder.Name,
		Config = config,
		RedPads = redPads,
		BluePads = bluePads,
		PadOccupants = padOccupants,
		OccupantLastSeen = {},
		CandidateArrivals = {},
		CandidateLastSeen = {},
		CurrentRed = {},
		CurrentBlue = {},
		State = "WAITING",
		ActiveReservation = nil,
		LastModeNotPlayableWarn = nil,
	}

	-- Registrar en MatchmakingFeedbackService
	local feedbackService = self:_getFeedbackService()
	if feedbackService then
		feedbackService:RegisterZone(zoneFolder)
	end

	self._zones[zoneFolder] = zoneData
	print(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona registrada: '%s' (ZoneId=%s, Modo=%s, TeamSize=%d, MaxTotal=%d)",
		zoneFolder.Name, zoneId, config.Mode, config.TeamSize, config.TotalPlayers))
end

function MatchmakingService:_unregisterZone(zoneFolder: Folder)
	local zoneData = self._zones[zoneFolder]
	if not zoneData then return end

	-- Cleanup en feedback audiovisual
	local feedbackService = self:_getFeedbackService()
	if feedbackService then
		feedbackService:UnregisterZone(zoneFolder)
	end

	-- Emitir snapshot vacío final a los clientes si la zona tenía jugadores
	if #zoneData.CurrentRed > 0 or #zoneData.CurrentBlue > 0 then
		if self._queueStatusRemote then
			local finalSnapshot: QueueSnapshot = {
				ZoneId = zoneData.ZoneId,
				ZoneName = zoneData.ZoneName,
				Mode = zoneData.Config.Mode,
				TeamSize = zoneData.Config.TeamSize,
				MaxPlayersPerTeam = zoneData.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
				TotalPlayers = zoneData.Config.TotalPlayers,
				Red = {},
				Blue = {},
				State = "WAITING",
			}
			self._queueStatusRemote:FireAllClients(finalSnapshot)
		end
	end

	-- Limpieza de caché de snapshots
	self._latestSnapshots[zoneData.ZoneId] = nil
	self._latestSnapshots[zoneData.ZoneName] = nil

	-- Limpieza de tablas de ocupación
	table.clear(zoneData.PadOccupants)
	table.clear(zoneData.OccupantLastSeen)
	table.clear(zoneData.CandidateArrivals)
	table.clear(zoneData.CandidateLastSeen)
	table.clear(zoneData.CurrentRed)
	table.clear(zoneData.CurrentBlue)
	zoneData.ActiveReservation = nil

	self._zones[zoneFolder] = nil
	print(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Zona desregistrada y limpiada: '%s' (ZoneId=%s)",
		zoneFolder.Name, zoneData.ZoneId))
end

-- Limpia de forma inmediata reservas huérfanas al desconectarse un jugador
function MatchmakingService:_handlePlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local needsUpdate = false
	for _, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		zone.OccupantLastSeen[player] = nil
		zone.CandidateArrivals[player] = nil
		zone.CandidateLastSeen[player] = nil

		for pad, occupants in pairs(zone.PadOccupants) do
			local idx = table.find(occupants, player)
			if idx then
				table.remove(occupants, idx)
				needsUpdate = true
			end
		end
	end

	if needsUpdate then
		self:_updateQueue()
	end
end

function MatchmakingService:Start(context)
	self._context = context

	-- Monitoreo de ocupación cada 0.3s
	self._checkConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - self._lastCheck < 0.3 then return end
		self._lastCheck = now
		self:_updateQueue()
	end)

	-- Limpieza inmediata cuando un jugador se desconecta del servidor
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		self:_handlePlayerRemoving(player)
	end)

	print("[MatchmakingService] Servicio de matchmaking genérico iniciado")
end

-- Compara si dos listas de jugadores son idénticas
local function arePlayerListsEqual(a: { Player }, b: { Player }): boolean
	if #a ~= #b then return false end
	for i = 1, #a do
		if a[i] ~= b[i] then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function MatchmakingService:_updateQueue()
	local feedbackService = self:_getFeedbackService()
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	local now = os.clock()

	-- Construir lista de personajes para OverlapParams
	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	local characterList = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Character then
			table.insert(characterList, player.Character)
		end
	end
	if self._testCharacterMap then
		for charModel, _ in pairs(self._testCharacterMap) do
			if charModel:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
				table.insert(characterList, charModel)
			end
		end
	end
	overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = characterList

	for zoneFolder, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		-- Si la zona fue destruida o desparentada, desregistrar y omitir
		if not zoneFolder or not zoneFolder:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			self:_unregisterZone(zoneFolder)
			continue
		end

		-- Conjunto de ocupantes actuales de Blue para pasárselo a Red
		local currentBlueSet: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(zone.CurrentBlue) do
			currentBlueSet[p] = true
		end

		local redOccupants = updateTeamOccupants(
			zone,
			zone.RedPads,
			zone.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
			currentBlueSet,
			overlapParams,
			now,
			self
		)

		-- Conjunto de ocupantes actualizados de Red para pasárselo a Blue
		local currentRedSet: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, p in ipairs(redOccupants) do
			currentRedSet[p] = true
		end

		local blueOccupants = updateTeamOccupants(
			zone,
			zone.BluePads,
			zone.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
			currentRedSet,
			overlapParams,
			now,
			self
		)

		local redChanged = not arePlayerListsEqual(zone.CurrentRed, redOccupants)
		local blueChanged = not arePlayerListsEqual(zone.CurrentBlue, blueOccupants)

		zone.CurrentRed = redOccupants
		zone.CurrentBlue = blueOccupants
		if roundService and roundService.CancelPreparationIfOccupancyLost then
			roundService:CancelPreparationIfOccupancyLost(zone.ZoneId)
		end

		-- Actualizar feedback audiovisual discreto por instancia de zona
		if feedbackService then
			feedbackService:SetPadOccupied(zoneFolder, "Red", #redOccupants > 0, redOccupants[1])
			feedbackService:SetPadOccupied(zoneFolder, "Blue", #blueOccupants > 0, blueOccupants[1])
		end

		-- Determinar candidatos comprometidos según TeamSize
		local committedRed: { Player } = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(#redOccupants, zone.Config.TeamSize) do
			table.insert(committedRed, redOccupants[i])
		end
		local committedBlue: { Player } = {}
		for i = 1, math.min(#blueOccupants, zone.Config.TeamSize) do
			table.insert(committedBlue, blueOccupants[i])
		end

		-- Verificar que los equipos sean disjuntos
		local disjoint = true
		for _, r in ipairs(committedRed) do
			if table.find(committedBlue, r) then
				disjoint = false
				break
			end
		end

		-- Verificar que ninguno de los participantes esté registrado en otra partida
		local anyAlreadyInMatch = false
		if roundService and roundService.GetSessionForPlayer then
			for _, p in ipairs(committedRed) do
				if roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(p) ~= nil then
					anyAlreadyInMatch = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not anyAlreadyInMatch then
				for _, p in ipairs(committedBlue) do
					if roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(p) ~= nil then
						anyAlreadyInMatch = true
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local isReady = (#committedRed == zone.Config.TeamSize)
			and (#committedBlue == zone.Config.TeamSize)
			and disjoint
			and not anyAlreadyInMatch

		-- Gestionar token autoritativo de reserva
		if isReady then
			-- Comprobar si la reserva existente sigue siendo válida para la misma plantilla
			local currentRes = zone.ActiveReservation
			local needsNewRes = true
			if currentRes and (os.clock() <= currentRes.ExpiresAt) then
				if currentRes.Mode == zone.Config.Mode
					and currentRes.TeamSize == zone.Config.TeamSize
					and #currentRes.RedTeam == #committedRed
					and #currentRes.BlueTeam == #committedBlue
				then
					local matches = true
					for i = 1, #committedRed do
						if currentRes.RedTeam[i] ~= committedRed[i] then
							matches = false
							break
						end
					end
					if matches then
						for i = 1, #committedBlue do
							if currentRes.BlueTeam[i] ~= committedBlue[i] then
								matches = false
								break
							end
						end
					end
					if matches then
						needsNewRes = false
					end
				end
			end

			if needsNewRes then
				self:CreateReservation(zone.ZoneId, zone.Config.Mode, zone.Config.TeamSize, committedRed, committedBlue)
			end
		else
			-- Si no está listo, invalidar cualquier reserva previa
			zone.ActiveReservation = nil
		end

		local newState: QueueStateName = if isReady then "READY" else "WAITING"
		local stateChanged = zone.State ~= newState
		zone.State = newState

		-- Emitir QueueSnapshot cuando hay cambios o para sincronización
		if redChanged or blueChanged or stateChanged or (zone :: any).ForceSnapshot then
			(zone :: any).ForceSnapshot = nil
			local snapshot: QueueSnapshot = {
				ZoneId = zone.ZoneId,
				ZoneName = zone.ZoneName,
				Mode = zone.Config.Mode,
				TeamSize = zone.Config.TeamSize,
				MaxPlayersPerTeam = zone.Config.MaxPlayersPerTeam,
				TotalPlayers = zone.Config.TotalPlayers,
				Red = redOccupants,
				Blue = blueOccupants,
				State = newState,
			}

			self._latestSnapshots[zone.ZoneId] = snapshot
			self._latestSnapshots[zone.ZoneName] = snapshot

			if self._queueStatusRemote then
				self._queueStatusRemote:FireAllClients(snapshot)
			end
		end

		-- Disparar inicio de partida cuando la cola está lista y RoundService disponible
		if isReady and roundService and roundService:IsAvailable() then
			local token = if zone.ActiveReservation then zone.ActiveReservation.Token else nil
			local admissionRequest: Types.TeamMatchAdmissionRequest = {
				ZoneId = zone.ZoneId,
				Mode = zone.Config.Mode,
				TeamSize = zone.Config.TeamSize,
				RedTeam = committedRed,
				BlueTeam = committedBlue,
				ReservationToken = token,
			}

			local ok, reason = roundService:StartTeamMatch(admissionRequest)
			if not ok then
				if reason == "ModeNotPlayable" then
					if zone.LastModeNotPlayableWarn ~= zone.Config.Mode then
						zone.LastModeNotPlayableWarn = zone.Config.Mode
						print(string.format("[MatchmakingService] Modalidad '%s' en zona '%s' admitida estructuralmente pero bloqueada para juego real (ModeNotPlayable)",
							zone.Config.Mode, zone.ZoneId))
					end
				else
					-- No silenciar otros errores
				end
			else
				zone.LastModeNotPlayableWarn = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Consulta de snapshot público (por Folder, ZoneId o ZoneName)
function MatchmakingService:GetQueueSnapshot(identifier: any): QueueSnapshot?
	if typeof(identifier) == "Instance" and identifier:IsA("Folder") then
		local data = self._zones[identifier]
		return data and self._latestSnapshots[data.ZoneId]
	elseif typeof(identifier) == "string" then
		return self._latestSnapshots[identifier]
	end
	return self._latestSnapshots["1v1"] or next(self._latestSnapshots)
end

	if typeof(identifier) == "Instance" and identifier:IsA("Folder") then
		local data = self._zones[identifier]
		return data and data.Config
	elseif typeof(identifier) == "string" then
		for _, data in pairs(self._zones) do

		end

-- Crea una reserva autoritativa para una plantilla lista
function MatchmakingService:CreateReservation(
	zoneId: string,
	mode: string,
	teamSize: number,
	redTeam: { Player },
	blueTeam: { Player },
	ttlSeconds: number?
): Types.TeamMatchReservation?
	local targetZone: ZoneData? = nil
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ZoneId == zoneId then
			targetZone = z
			break
		end
	end
	if not targetZone then return nil end

	local ttl = ttlSeconds or (Config.Matchmaking and Config.Matchmaking.ReservationTTL) or 15
	local now = os.clock()
	local token = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)

	local redCopy: { Player } = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(redTeam) do table.insert(redCopy, p) end
	local blueCopy: { Player } = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(blueTeam) do table.insert(blueCopy, p) end

	local reservation: Types.TeamMatchReservation = {
		Token = token,
		ZoneId = zoneId,
		Mode = mode,
		TeamSize = teamSize,
		RedTeam = redCopy,
		BlueTeam = blueCopy,
		CreatedAt = now,
		ExpiresAt = now + ttl,
	}

	targetZone.ActiveReservation = reservation
	return reservation
end

-- Obtiene la reserva autoritativa activa de una zona
function MatchmakingService:GetActiveReservation(zoneId: string): Types.TeamMatchReservation?
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ZoneId == zoneId then
			return z.ActiveReservation
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Valida que un token corresponda exactamente a la plantilla y zona activa sin haber expirado
function MatchmakingService:ValidateReservation(
	token: string,
	request: Types.TeamMatchAdmissionRequest
): (boolean, string?)
	if not token or token == "" then
		return false, "MissingReservationToken"
	end

	local foundZone: ZoneData? = nil
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ActiveReservation and z.ActiveReservation.Token == token then
			foundZone = z
			break
		end
	end

	if not foundZone or not foundZone.ActiveReservation then
		return false, "ReservationNotFound"
	end

	local res = foundZone.ActiveReservation
	local now = os.clock()
	if now > res.ExpiresAt then
		foundZone.ActiveReservation = nil
		return false, "ReservationExpired"
	end

	if res.ZoneId ~= request.ZoneId then
		return false, "ReservationZoneMismatch"
	end

	if res.Mode ~= request.Mode then
		return false, "ReservationModeMismatch"
	end

	if res.TeamSize ~= request.TeamSize then
		return false, "ReservationTeamSizeMismatch"
	end

	if #res.RedTeam ~= #request.RedTeam or #res.BlueTeam ~= #request.BlueTeam then
		return false, "ReservationRosterMismatch"
	end

	for i = 1, #res.RedTeam do
		if res.RedTeam[i] ~= request.RedTeam[i] then
			return false, "ReservationRosterMismatch"
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #res.BlueTeam do
		if res.BlueTeam[i] ~= request.BlueTeam[i] then
			return false, "ReservationRosterMismatch"
		end
	end

	return true, nil
end

-- Consume de forma atómica una reserva al ser admitida la partida
function MatchmakingService:ConsumeReservation(token: string): boolean
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ActiveReservation and z.ActiveReservation.Token == token then
			z.ActiveReservation = nil
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Invalida de forma explícita la reserva de una zona
-- Preserve physical occupancy/FIFO; only invalidate this preparation's reservation.
function MatchmakingService:ReleasePreparation(zoneId: string, token: string?)
	for _,zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		if zone.ZoneId == zoneId then
			if zone.ActiveReservation and zone.ActiveReservation.Token == token then zone.ActiveReservation = nil end
			(zone :: any).ForceSnapshot = true
			return
		end
	end
end

function MatchmakingService:InvalidateReservation(zoneId: string)
	for _, z in pairs(self._zones) do
		if z.ZoneId == zoneId then
			z.ActiveReservation = nil
			break
		end
	end
end

-- Verifica de manera server-authoritative si los jugadores siguen siendo los ocupantes registrados de su zona
function MatchmakingService:ArePlayersInZone(
	zoneId: string,
	redPlayerOrTeam: Player | { Player },
	bluePlayerOrTeam: Player | { Player },
	requirePhysical: boolean?
): boolean
	if not zoneId or not redPlayerOrTeam or not bluePlayerOrTeam then
		return false
	end

	local redList: { Player } = if typeof(redPlayerOrTeam) == "table" and not (redPlayerOrTeam :: any).IsSimulatedPlayer then (redPlayerOrTeam :: { Player }) else { redPlayerOrTeam :: Player }
	local blueList: { Player } = if typeof(bluePlayerOrTeam) == "table" and not (bluePlayerOrTeam :: any).IsSimulatedPlayer then (bluePlayerOrTeam :: { Player }) else { bluePlayerOrTeam :: Player }

	if #redList == 0 or #blueList == 0 then
		return false
	end

	for _, p in ipairs(redList) do
		if not isPlayerAliveAndValid(p) then return false end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(blueList) do
		if not isPlayerAliveAndValid(p) then return false end
	end

	-- 1. Resolver la zona mediante ZoneId
	local targetZone: ZoneData? = nil
	for _, zone in pairs(self._zones) do
		if zone.ZoneId == zoneId then
			targetZone = zone
			break
		end
	end

	if not targetZone then
		return false
	end

	-- Verificar existencia de la instancia física
	if not targetZone.Instance or not targetZone.Instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return false
	end

	-- 2. Verificar que todos los jugadores de cada equipo están registrados en la zona
	for _, p in ipairs(redList) do
		if not table.find(targetZone.CurrentRed, p) then
			return false
		end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(blueList) do
		if not table.find(targetZone.CurrentBlue, p) then
			return false
		end
	end

	if requirePhysical then
		local params=OverlapParams.new()
		params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		local characters={}
		for _,list in ipairs({redList,blueList}) do for _,p in ipairs(list) do table.insert(characters,p.Character) end end
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances=characters
		for _,entry in ipairs({{Pads=targetZone.RedPads,Players=redList},{Pads=targetZone.BluePads,Players=blueList}}) do
			local present={}
			for _,pad in ipairs(entry.Pads) do for _,p in ipairs(getPhysicallyPresentPlayersOnPad(pad,params)) do present[p]=true end end
			for _,p in ipairs(entry.Players) do if not present[p] then return false end end
		end
	end
	return true
end

return MatchmakingService

--!strict
-- SpawnService
-- Responsable de obtener los spawnpoints de la partida, posicionar a RedPlayer y BluePlayer,
-- validar que ambos spawn existan, evitar que los jugadores aparezcan dentro del suelo,
-- e integrarse con RoundService durante MapLoading y el retorno al lobby.
-- NO implementa: respawn, muerte, combate, knockback, eliminacion, checkpoints ni herramientas.

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

local Constants = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Constants)
local Types = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Types)
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local ArenaRespawn = require(script.Parent.Respawn.ArenaRespawn)
local CharacterPhysics = require(script.Parent.Respawn.CharacterPhysics)

print("[SpawnService] MovementLock diagnostic version loaded")

type MatchSession = Types.MatchSession
type SessionParticipant = Types.SessionParticipant
type SpawnBatchResult = Types.SpawnBatchResult

local SpawnService = {}
SpawnService.Name = "SpawnService"

SpawnService._context = nil
SpawnService._lobbySpawn = nil :: SpawnLocation?
SpawnService._returnConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?

function SpawnService:Init(context)
	self._context = context
	self._arenaRespawn = ArenaRespawn.new(self)
	CharacterPhysics.Configure()
	self._respawnConnections = {}
	self._respawnPlayerConnections = {}

	-- Validar existencia de Workspace.Lobby.SpawnLocation
	local lobby = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
	local spawnLocation = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation")
	if spawnLocation and spawnLocation:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
		self._lobbySpawn = spawnLocation
	else
		warn("[SpawnService] Workspace.Lobby.SpawnLocation no encontrado o invalido")
	end
end

function SpawnService:Start(context)
	self._context = context
	local function track(player: Player)
		if self._respawnPlayerConnections[player] then return end
		self._respawnPlayerConnections[player] = {
			player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
				local pending = self._arenaRespawn.Pending[player]
				if pending and pending.Character == character then self._arenaRespawn:Cancel(player, "CharacterRemoving", false) end
					CharacterPhysics.Forget(character)
			end),
			player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
				local pending = self._arenaRespawn.Pending[player]
				if pending and pending.Character ~= character then self._arenaRespawn:Cancel(player, "CharacterReplaced", false) end
					CharacterPhysics.Track(character)
			end),
			player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MatchId"):Connect(function()
				local pending = self._arenaRespawn.Pending[player]
				if pending and player:GetAttribute("MatchId") ~= pending.Session.Id then self._arenaRespawn:Cancel(player, "MatchChanged", false) end
			end),
		}
			if player.Character then CharacterPhysics.Track(player.Character) end
	end
	table.insert(self._respawnConnections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(track))
	table.insert(self._respawnConnections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self._arenaRespawn:Cancel(player, "PlayerRemoving", false)
		if player.Character then CharacterPhysics.Forget(player.Character) end
		for _,connection in ipairs(self._respawnPlayerConnections[player] or {}) do connection:Disconnect() end
		self._respawnPlayerConnections[player] = nil
	end))
	for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do track(player) end

	-- Conectar a la señal de RoundService para retornar jugadores al lobby
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if roundService and roundService.ReturnPlayersToLobby then
		self._returnConnection = roundService.ReturnPlayersToLobby:Connect(function(data: any)
			if type(data) == "table" then
				self:ReturnPlayersToLobby(data.RedPlayer, data.BluePlayer)
			end
		end)
	end

	print("[SpawnService] Servicio iniciado y listo para gestionar posicionamiento de jugadores")
end

function SpawnService:_getMatchInstanceService()

function SpawnService:_getSpawnPoints(session: MatchSession): (BasePart?, BasePart?)
	-- 1. Intentar desde session.InstanceInfo si ya esta cacheado
	if session.InstanceInfo then
		return session.InstanceInfo.TeamSpawns.Red[1], session.InstanceInfo.TeamSpawns.Blue[1]
	end

	-- 2. Consultar a MatchInstanceService
	local matchInstanceService = self:_getMatchInstanceService()
	if matchInstanceService then
		return matchInstanceService:GetSpawnPoints(session.Id)
	end

	return nil, nil
end

function SpawnService:GetSpawnPoints(session: MatchSession): (BasePart?, BasePart?)
	return self:_getSpawnPoints(session)
end

local function isPlayer(p: any): boolean
	if not p then return false end
	if typeof(p) == "Instance" then
		return p:IsA("Player")
	end
	return false
end

-- Determina si un jugador pertenece activamente a una partida en curso
function SpawnService:IsPlayerInActiveMatch(player: Player): boolean
	if not player or not isPlayer(player) then return false end
	local matchId = player:GetAttribute("MatchId")
	if matchId and matchId ~= "" then
		return true
	end
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if roundService and type(roundService.GetSessionForPlayer) == "function" then
		local session = roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(player)
		if session and session.State ~= Constants.RoundState.Waiting and session.State ~= Constants.RoundState.ReturningToLobby then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Posiciona un personaje de jugador de forma segura sobre un spawnpart evitando que quede incrustado en el suelo
function SpawnService:TeleportCharacterToSpawn(player: Player, spawnPart: BasePart): boolean
	if not player or not spawnPart or not spawnPart:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		warn("[SpawnService] Parametros de teleportacion invalidos")
		return false
	end

	local character = player.Character
	local isLobby = spawnPart == self._lobbySpawn
	local originalCharacter = character
	local originalGeneration = character and character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration")
	local originalMatchId = player:GetAttribute("MatchId")
	if self._arenaRespawn then
		self._arenaRespawn:Cancel(player, "ExternalTeleport", false)
	end
	if character then character:SetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsPhase", if isLobby then "Lobby" else "Playing") end
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?

	-- Validar si el personaje existe, está activo y con vida
	local isAlive = character
		and character.Parent ~= nil
		and humanoid
		and humanoid.Health > 0
		and rootPart
		and rootPart.Position.Y > (workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 100)

	if not isAlive then
		if not isLobby and self:IsPlayerInActiveMatch(player) then
			-- REGLA FASE 4B: En MATCH, NUNCA invocar player:LoadCharacter()
			warn(string.format("[SpawnService] Personaje de '%s' no listo durante MatchSession. Esperando HumanoidRootPart sin recargar rig...", player.Name))
			character = player.Character
			if character then
				rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 2) :: BasePart?
				humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			end
			if not character or not rootPart or not humanoid then
				warn(string.format("[SpawnService] Imposible teletransportar '%s' en partida: Character no recuperable sin LoadCharacter.", player.Name))
				return false
			end
		else
			-- LOBBY: Recarga permitida exclusivamente como mecanismo fuera de match
			print(string.format("[SpawnService] Personaje de '%s' inactivo en Lobby. Recargando con LoadCharacter()...", player.Name))
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				player:LoadCharacter()
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn(string.format("[SpawnService] Error al forzar LoadCharacter() para '%s': %s", player.Name, tostring(err)))
				return false
			end
			character = player.Character
			if not character then
				local start = os.clock()
				while not player.Character and (os.clock() - start) < 2 do
					task.wait(0.05)
				end
				character = player.Character
			end
		end
	end

	if not character then
		warn(string.format("[SpawnService] Jugador '%s' no tiene personaje activo tras intento de carga", player.Name))
		return false
	end

	rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 3) :: BasePart?
	humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not rootPart or not humanoid then
		warn(string.format("[SpawnService] Personaje de '%s' no contiene HumanoidRootPart o Humanoid", player.Name))
		return false
	end
	if player.Character ~= character or player.Parent ~= Players then return false end
	if player:GetAttribute("MatchId") ~= originalMatchId
		or (character == originalCharacter and character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") ~= originalGeneration) then return false end
	CharacterPhysics.Restore(character)
	character:SetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsPhase", if isLobby then "Lobby" else "Playing")

	-- Si el jugador está dentro de un match, asegurar que Dead esté deshabilitado
	character:SetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration", (character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0) + 1)
	if not isLobby and self:IsPlayerInActiveMatch(player) then
		pcall(function()
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
		end)
	end

	-- Calculo de elevacion para evitar que el personaje aparezca dentro del suelo:
	-- (Mitad del grosor del spawn) + (HipHeight del Humanoid) + (Mitad de altura del RootPart) + margen de seguridad (0.5 studs)
	local spawnHalfThickness = spawnPart.Size.Y / 2
	local hipHeight = if humanoid.HipHeight > 0 then humanoid.HipHeight else 2.0
	local rootHalfHeight = rootPart.Size.Y / 2
	local safetyBuffer = 0.5

	local verticalClearance = spawnHalfThickness + hipHeight + rootHalfHeight + safetyBuffer

	-- Orientar al jugador segun la orientacion del spawn
		local targetCFrame = spawnPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, verticalClearance, 0)

	-- Detener cualquier inercia o velocidad previa del jugador en todas sus partes
	rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			desc.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			desc.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end

	-- Si el personaje estaba en ragdoll, restaurarlo inmediatamente cancelando timers pendientes
	local ragdollService = self:_getRagdollService()
	if ragdollService and type(ragdollService.ResetRagdollImmediate) == "function" then
		ragdollService:ResetRagdollImmediate(character, isLobby)
	elseif ragdollService then
		ragdollService:RemoveRagdoll(character)
	end

	character:PivotTo(targetCFrame * rootPart.CFrame:Inverse() * character:GetPivot())
	if not isLobby then
		local rounds = self:_getRoundService()
		local session = rounds and rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player)
		if session then
			(session :: any).ArenaTransferred = true
			(session :: any).TransferredPlayers = (session :: any).TransferredPlayers or {}
			(session :: any).TransferredPlayers[player] = true
		end
	end
	rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			desc.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			desc.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end

	print(string.format("[SpawnService] Jugador '%s' posicionado en '%s' (%s)",
			player.Name, spawnPart.Name, tostring(targetCFrame.Position)))

	return true
end

-- Determina el equipo de un jugador dentro de una partida activa
function SpawnService:_getPlayerTeam(session: MatchSession, player: Player): ("Red" | "Blue")?
	if not session or not player then return nil end

	if session.RedTeam and table.find(session.RedTeam, player) ~= nil then
		return "Red"
	elseif session.RedPlayer == player then
		return "Red"
	end

	if session.BlueTeam and table.find(session.BlueTeam, player) ~= nil then
		return "Blue"
	elseif session.BluePlayer == player then
		return "Blue"
	end

	return nil
end

function SpawnService:_getParticipant(session: MatchSession, player: Player): SessionParticipant?
	if not session or not player then return nil end
	for _, participant in ipairs(session.Participants or {}) do
		if participant.Player == player and participant.State ~= "Released" then
			return participant
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Resolver autoritativo reutilizable para carga, reinicios y recuperación de caídas.
-- La sesión registrada, el participante y la instancia física deben coincidir.
function SpawnService:ResolveParticipantSpawn(sessionId: string, player: Player): (BasePart?, string?)
	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	if not roundService or type(roundService.GetSessionById) ~= "function" then
		return nil, "RoundServiceUnavailable"
	end
	local session = roundService:GetSessionById(sessionId)
	if not session or session.Id ~= sessionId then return nil, "SessionNotRegistered" end
	if roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(player) ~= session then return nil, "PlayerSessionMismatch" end

	local participant = self:_getParticipant(session, player)
	if not participant then return nil, "ParticipantNotRegistered" end
	if participant.State == "Left" then return nil, "ParticipantLeft" end

	local instanceService = self:_getMatchInstanceService()
	local instanceInfo = instanceService and instanceService:GetInstance(sessionId)
	if not instanceInfo or session.InstanceInfo ~= instanceInfo or instanceInfo.MatchId ~= sessionId then
		return nil, "MatchInstanceMismatch"
	end
	local spawnPart = instanceService:GetSpawnPoint(sessionId, participant.Team, participant.Slot)
	if not spawnPart or not spawnPart:IsDescendantOf(instanceInfo.Container) then
		return nil, "SpawnUnavailable"
	end
	return spawnPart, nil
end

-- Posiciona a un jugador individual en el spawn correspondiente a su equipo dentro de la partida activa
function SpawnService:SpawnPlayerInMatch(session: MatchSession, player: Player): boolean
	if not session or not player then
		warn("[SpawnService] MatchSession o Player invalido para SpawnPlayerInMatch")
		return false
	end

	local participant = self:_getParticipant(session, player)
	if not participant then
		warn(string.format("[SpawnService] Jugador '%s' no pertenece al Match '%s'", player.Name, session.Id))
		return false
	end
	local targetSpawn, reason = self:ResolveParticipantSpawn(session.Id, player)

	if not targetSpawn or not targetSpawn:IsA("BasePart") or not targetSpawn:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		warn(string.format("[SpawnService] Spawn %s/%d no valido para Match '%s': %s", participant.Team, participant.Slot, session.Id, tostring(reason)))
		return false
	end

	-- Blindaje del Humanoid al ingresar al Match (Fase 4B Zero-Death)
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			pcall(function()
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
			end)
		end
	end

	return self:TeleportCharacterToSpawn(player, targetSpawn)
end

-- Reposiciona el Character EXISTENTE de un jugador dentro de su MatchInstance (Zero-Death)
-- Garantiza:
-- 1. NO invoca player:LoadCharacter().
-- 2. NO reemplaza ni destruye el Character existente.
-- 3. Resuelve TeamSpawn exclusivamente desde MatchId y MatchTeam (aislamiento multi-match).
-- 4. Invoca RagdollService:ResetRagdollImmediate() para restaurar locomoción y cancelar timers.
-- 5. Anula AssemblyLinearVelocity y AssemblyAngularVelocity antes y después de PivotTo.
-- 6. Aplica elevación vertical y orientación de forma segura para no incrustar en el suelo.
function SpawnService:ResetCharacterInArena(player: Player, expectedSessionId: string?): boolean
	if not player or not player:IsDescendantOf(game:GetService("Players")) then
		warn("[SpawnService] Player invalido o desconectado para ResetCharacterInArena")
		return false
	end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not character.Parent or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		warn(string.format("[SpawnService] Jugador '%s' no tiene Character valido en Workspace", player.Name))
		return false
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not humanoid or not rootPart then
		warn(string.format("[SpawnService] Personaje de '%s' carece de Humanoid o HumanoidRootPart", player.Name))
		return false
	end

	local roundService = self:_getRoundService()
	local session = roundService and roundService:GetSessionForPlayer(player)
	if not session or (expectedSessionId and session.Id ~= expectedSessionId) then
		warn(string.format("[SpawnService] Sesion autoritativa ausente o distinta para '%s'", player.Name))
		return false
	end
	local participant = self:_getParticipant(session, player)
	local targetSpawn, reason = self:ResolveParticipantSpawn(session.Id, player)
	if not participant or not targetSpawn then
		warn(string.format("[SpawnService] No se pudo resolver spawn autoritativo para '%s': %s", player.Name, tostring(reason)))
		return false
	end
	local pending = self._arenaRespawn and self._arenaRespawn.Pending[player]
	if pending and pending.Thread and pending.Thread ~= coroutine.running() then
		pcall(task.cancel, pending.Thread)
		pending.Thread = nil
	end
	character:SetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration", (character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0) + 1)

	-- 1. Resetear inmediatamente el estado de Ragdoll y cancelar callbacks pendientes
	local ragdollService = self:_getRagdollService()
	if ragdollService and type(ragdollService.ResetRagdollImmediate) == "function" then
		ragdollService:ResetRagdollImmediate(character, pending ~= nil)
	elseif ragdollService then
		ragdollService:RemoveRagdoll(character)
	end

	-- 2. Limpiar velocidades e impulsos antes del teleport
	rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			desc.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			desc.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end

	-- 3. Calcular CFrame objetivo con elevación de seguridad
	local spawnHalfThickness = targetSpawn.Size.Y / 2
	local hipHeight = if humanoid.HipHeight > 0 then humanoid.HipHeight else 2.0
	local rootHalfHeight = rootPart.Size.Y / 2
	local safetyBuffer = 0.5
	if pending then
		-- Official rig clearance: R6 includes leg length; R15 uses HipHeight.
		local leg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") :: BasePart?
		hipHeight = math.max(0, humanoid.HipHeight)
		if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and leg then hipHeight += leg.Size.Y end
		safetyBuffer = 0.05
	end
	local verticalClearance = spawnHalfThickness + hipHeight + rootHalfHeight + safetyBuffer

		local targetCFrame = targetSpawn.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, verticalClearance, 0)

	-- 4. Reposicionar el Character EXISTENTE
	if pending then
		-- Position the root exactly, independent of Model pivot offsets.
		character:PivotTo(targetCFrame * rootPart.CFrame:Inverse() * character:GetPivot())
	else
		character:PivotTo(targetCFrame)
	end

	-- 5. Limpieza física secundaria post-PivotTo para cancelar inercia residual
	rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	if pending then
		local exclude: { Instance } = { character }
		for _,other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if other.Character then table.insert(exclude, other.Character) end
		end
		local overlap = OverlapParams.new()
		overlap.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclude
		overlap.RespectCanCollide = true
		overlap.MaxParts = 1
		for _,body in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
			if body:IsA("BasePart") and #Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(body.CFrame, body.Size * 0.95, overlap) > 0 then
				warn("[ArenaRespawn] Unsafe spawn overlap", player.Name, targetSpawn:GetFullName(), body.Name)
				return false
			end
		end
		self._arenaRespawn:Take(player)
		self._arenaRespawn:Restore(pending)
	end

	-- 6. Garantizar que Humanoid pueda caminar y mantener Dead bloqueado (Zero-Death)
	if humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Jump = false
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		local isLocked = humanoid:GetAttribute("MovementLocked") == true
		if not isLocked then
			humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		end
		pcall(function()
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
		end)
	end

	print(string.format("[SpawnService] ResetCharacterInArena exitoso para '%s' en '%s' (Match '%s', Team '%s')",
		player.Name, targetSpawn.Name, session.Id, participant.Team))
	CharacterPhysics.Trace(player, "ArenaPositioned", targetSpawn, session.State)

	return true
end

function SpawnService:IsKillPartRespawnPending(player: Player): boolean
	return self._arenaRespawn ~= nil and self._arenaRespawn.Pending[player] ~= nil
end

function SpawnService:BeginKillPartRespawn(player: Player, session: MatchSession, eliminationId: string, kind: string?): boolean
	local rounds = self:_getRoundService()
	if not player or player.Parent ~= Players or not session or not rounds
		or rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player) ~= session or not rounds:IsSessionActive(session.Id)
		or not rounds:GetSessionParticipant(session.Id, player) then return false end
	if session.State ~= Constants.RoundState.Playing or session.PointInProgress or session.GameplayFrozen then return false end
	return self._arenaRespawn:Begin(player, session, eliminationId, kind)
end

function SpawnService:CancelSessionRespawns(sessionId: string, reason: string)
	if self._arenaRespawn then self._arenaRespawn:CancelSession(sessionId, reason, true) end
end

-- Obtiene la lista de jugadores participantes válidos de una MatchSession
-- Reutiliza la misma estrategia que SpawnMatchPlayers() soportando RedTeam/BlueTeam y RedPlayer/BluePlayer
function SpawnService:GetSessionParticipants(session: MatchSession?): { Player }
	if not session then return {} end
	local participants: { Player } = {}

	local addPlayer = function(p: any)
		if isPlayer(p) and p:IsDescendantOf(Players) then
			if not table.find(participants, p) then
				table.insert(participants, p)
			end
		end
	end

	if session.RedTeam and #session.RedTeam > 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(session.RedTeam) do
			addPlayer(p)
		end
	elseif session.RedPlayer then
		addPlayer(session.RedPlayer)
	end

	if session.BlueTeam and #session.BlueTeam > 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(session.BlueTeam) do
			addPlayer(p)
		end
	elseif session.BluePlayer then
		addPlayer(session.BluePlayer)
	end

	for index, participant in ipairs(participants) do
		warn(
			"[DEBUG Participants]",
			index,
			tostring(participant),
			typeof(participant)
		)
	end

	return participants
end

-- Bloquea autoritativamente el movimiento del Character durante countdowns (Start / PointRestart)
-- Garantiza: WalkSpeed = 0, JumpPower = 0, JumpHeight = 0, AutoRotate = false, AssemblyVelocities = 0
-- NO usa Anchored, NO usa PlatformStand, NO crea Characters nuevos.
function SpawnService:LockCharacterMovement(player: Player?): boolean
	warn(
		"[DEBUG LockCharacterMovement]",
		"player=", tostring(player),
		"typeof=", typeof(player)
	)

	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" then
		warn("[DEBUG LockCharacterMovement] INVALID PLAYER:", tostring(player))
		return false
	end

	if not player:IsA("Player") then
		warn("[DEBUG LockCharacterMovement] INVALID CLASS:", player.ClassName)
		return false
	end

	if player.Parent ~= Players then
		warn("[DEBUG LockCharacterMovement] PLAYER NOT IN PLAYERS:", player:GetFullName())
		return false
	end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not character.Parent or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		return false
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not rootPart then
		return false
	end

	local defaultWalkSpeed = (Config.Character and Config.Character.DefaultWalkSpeed) or 16
	local defaultJumpPower = (Config.Character and Config.Character.DefaultJumpPower) or 50
	local defaultJumpHeight = (Config.Character and Config.Character.DefaultJumpHeight) or 7.2

	if not humanoid:GetAttribute("BaseWalkSpeed") then
		local currentSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
		humanoid:SetAttribute("BaseWalkSpeed", if currentSpeed > 0 then currentSpeed else defaultWalkSpeed)
	end
	if not humanoid:GetAttribute("BaseJumpPower") then
		local currentPower = humanoid.JumpPower
		humanoid:SetAttribute("BaseJumpPower", if currentPower > 0 then currentPower else defaultJumpPower)
	end
	if not humanoid:GetAttribute("BaseJumpHeight") then
		local currentHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight
		humanoid:SetAttribute("BaseJumpHeight", if currentHeight > 0 then currentHeight else defaultJumpHeight)
	end

	humanoid:SetAttribute("MovementLocked", true)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
	humanoid.JumpPower = 0
	humanoid.JumpHeight = 0
	humanoid.AutoRotate = false

	-- Detener cualquier inercia o velocidad física residual
	rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	for _, desc in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			desc.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			desc.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- Restaura autoritativamente el movimiento normal del Character al pasar a PLAYING o Lobby
function SpawnService:UnlockCharacterMovement(player: Player?): boolean
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return false
	end

	local character = player.Character
	if not character or not character.Parent then
		return false
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return false
	end

	local defaultWalkSpeed = (Config.Character and Config.Character.DefaultWalkSpeed) or 16
	local defaultJumpPower = (Config.Character and Config.Character.DefaultJumpPower) or 50
	local defaultJumpHeight = (Config.Character and Config.Character.DefaultJumpHeight) or 7.2

	local baseWalkSpeed = humanoid:GetAttribute("BaseWalkSpeed")
	local baseJumpPower = humanoid:GetAttribute("BaseJumpPower")
	local baseJumpHeight = humanoid:GetAttribute("BaseJumpHeight")

	humanoid:SetAttribute("MovementLocked", nil)
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = if typeof(baseWalkSpeed) == "number" and baseWalkSpeed > 0 then baseWalkSpeed else defaultWalkSpeed
	humanoid.JumpPower = if typeof(baseJumpPower) == "number" and baseJumpPower > 0 then baseJumpPower else defaultJumpPower
	humanoid.JumpHeight = if typeof(baseJumpHeight) == "number" and baseJumpHeight > 0 then baseJumpHeight else defaultJumpHeight
	humanoid.AutoRotate = true

	return true
end

-- Bloquea movimiento para todos los participantes válidos de una sesión
function SpawnService:LockSessionPlayers(session: MatchSession)
	if not session then
		warn("[SpawnService] LockSessionPlayers: MatchSession nula o inválida")
		return
	end

	local participants = self:GetSessionParticipants(session)
	if #participants == 0 then
		warn(string.format("[SpawnService] LockSessionPlayers: no se encontraron participantes válidos para Match '%s'", tostring(session.Id)))
		return
	end

	if session.Mode == "1v1" and #participants < 2 then
		warn(string.format("[SpawnService] LockSessionPlayers: participante faltante en 1v1 para Match '%s' (encontrados: %d)",
			tostring(session.Id), #participants))
	end

	for _, player in ipairs(participants) do
		warn(
			"[DEBUG MovementLock]",
			"Match=", tostring(session.Id),
			"Participant=", tostring(player),
			"Type=", typeof(player),
			"Class=", if typeof(player) == "Instance" then player.ClassName else "N/A"
		)
		self:LockCharacterMovement(player)
	end
end

-- Restaura movimiento para todos los participantes válidos de una sesión
function SpawnService:UnlockSessionPlayers(session: MatchSession)
	if not session then
		warn("[SpawnService] UnlockSessionPlayers: MatchSession nula o inválida")
		return
	end

	local participants = self:GetSessionParticipants(session)
	for _, player in ipairs(participants) do
		self:UnlockCharacterMovement(player)
	end
end

-- Valida spawns de la partida y posiciona a RedPlayer y BluePlayer
function SpawnService:SpawnMatchPlayers(session: MatchSession): SpawnBatchResult
	local sessionId = if session then session.Id else ""
	local result: SpawnBatchResult = {
		Success = false,
		SessionId = sessionId,
		Required = 0,
		Placed = 0,
		PlacedPlayers = {},
		Failures = {},
	}
	if not session then
		warn("[SpawnService] MatchSession invalida")
		table.insert(result.Failures, { Reason = "InvalidSession" })
		return result
	end

	local participants = session.Participants or {}
	-- Resolve the whole batch before moving anyone. Never prepare only one side.
	for _, participant in ipairs(participants) do
		if participant.State ~= "Left" and participant.State ~= "Released" then
			local target, reason = self:ResolveParticipantSpawn(session.Id, participant.Player)
			if not target then
				table.insert(result.Failures, { Player=participant.Player, Reason=reason or "SpawnUnavailable" })
			end
		end
	end
	if #result.Failures > 0 then
		for _,participant in ipairs(participants) do if participant.State~="Left" and participant.State~="Released" then result.Required+=1 end end
		return result
	end
	for _, participant in ipairs(participants) do
		if participant.State ~= "Left" and participant.State ~= "Released" then
			result.Required += 1
			local spawnPart, reason = self:ResolveParticipantSpawn(session.Id, participant.Player)
			if not spawnPart then
				table.insert(result.Failures, { Player = participant.Player, UserId = participant.UserId, Team = participant.Team, Slot = participant.Slot, Reason = reason or "SpawnUnavailable" })
			elseif self:TeleportCharacterToSpawn(participant.Player, spawnPart) then
				result.Placed += 1
				table.insert(result.PlacedPlayers, participant.Player)
			else
				table.insert(result.Failures, { Player = participant.Player, UserId = participant.UserId, Team = participant.Team, Slot = participant.Slot, Reason = "TeleportFailed" })
			end
		end
	end
	result.Success = result.Required > 0 and result.Placed == result.Required and #result.Failures == 0
	print(string.format("[SpawnService] Posicionamiento Match '%s': %d/%d; Success=%s", session.Id, result.Placed, result.Required, tostring(result.Success)))

	-- Asegurar que los jugadores cuenten con su Slap equipado tras el reposicionamiento
	local slapService = self:_getSlapService()
	if result.Success and slapService then
		for _,p in ipairs(result.PlacedPlayers) do slapService:GiveSlap(p) end
	end

	return result
end

-- Retorna a los jugadores al punto de spawn del lobby reutilizando sus Characters existentes
function SpawnService:ReturnPlayersToLobby(redPlayer: any?, bluePlayer: any?): boolean
	local lobbySpawn = self._lobbySpawn
	if not lobbySpawn or not lobbySpawn:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		local lobby = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
		lobbySpawn = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation") :: SpawnLocation?
		self._lobbySpawn = lobbySpawn
	end

	if not lobbySpawn then
		warn("[SpawnService] No se puede retornar al lobby: SpawnLocation no encontrado")
		return false
	end

	local ragdollService = self:_getRagdollService()
	local allReturned = true

	local returnSinglePlayer = function(player: Player?)
		if not player or not player:IsA("Player") or not player:IsDescendantOf(Players) then return end
		local character = player.Character
			-- Invalidate competitive work BEFORE recovery/teleport, including individual results exits.
			self._arenaRespawn:Cancel(player, "ReturnToLobby", false)
			if character then
				character:SetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration", (character:GetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsGeneration") or 0) + 1)
				character:SetAttribute("ArenaPhysicsPhase", "Lobby")
				CharacterPhysics.Restore(character)
			end
		if character and character.Parent then
			if ragdollService and type(ragdollService.ResetRagdollImmediate) == "function" then
				ragdollService:ResetRagdollImmediate(character)
			elseif ragdollService then
				ragdollService:RemoveRagdoll(character)
			end

			self:UnlockCharacterMovement(player)

			local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then
				pcall(function()
					hum.PlatformStand = false
					hum.AutoRotate = true
					hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
					hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
					hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
				end)
			end
		end

			if not self:TeleportCharacterToSpawn(player, lobbySpawn) then
			allReturned = false
		end
			if player.Character then CharacterPhysics.Restore(player.Character) end
			local returnedHumanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if returnedHumanoid then
				returnedHumanoid.Jump = false
				returnedHumanoid.PlatformStand = false
				returnedHumanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
				returnedHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
			end
			local rounds = self:_getRoundService()
			local returningSession = rounds and rounds:GetSessionForPlayer(player)
			CharacterPhysics.Trace(player, "LobbyReturned", lobbySpawn, returningSession and returningSession.State)

		-- Limpieza inmediata de identidad de match a nivel de player
		pcall(function()
			player:SetAttribute("MatchId", nil)
			player:SetAttribute("MatchTeam", nil)
		end)
	end

	local processTarget = function(target: any?)
		if not target then return end
		if type(target) == "table" and not (typeof(target) == "Instance") then
			for _, p in ipairs(target) do
				returnSinglePlayer(p)
			end
		else
			returnSinglePlayer(target)
		end
	end

	processTarget(redPlayer)
	processTarget(bluePlayer)

	print("[SpawnService] Jugadores retornados a Workspace.Lobby.SpawnLocation con estados normales restaurados")
	return allReturned
end

return SpawnService
